text: This free IDM alternative downloads up to 15 times faster than Chrome. It even grabs videos from YouTube and 1,800+ sites in up to 8K. Meet Prism, an open-source download manager. Prism splits downloads across up to 32 connections, and finished connections help download the remaining parts. If your laptop sleeps or the power cuts, it resumes where it stopped. You can even download just a clip of a video, cut at the exact frame you want. Comment "PRISM" and I'll DM you the Github repo link.
